Each [[Operator]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]'' has a specific '''Element''' assigned which describes the main type of damage they deal and effects they can inflict.

==Physical==
Physical [[Operator]]s are capable of dealing Physical Damage, shown in game as a white number.

{{List box|
    {{#cargo_query:
        |tables=Operators
        |fields=CONCAT("{{((}}C{{!}}", Operator, "{{!}}gridview=true{{))}}")=element_op
		|group by=Operator
        |order by=Operator ASC
        |where=Element="Physical"
        |delimiter = 
    }}
}}

Some Operators are also capable of dealing '''Physical Statuses''', often requiring the enemy to be '''Vulnerable''':

Certain Skills also forcibly apply Physical Statuses without requiring enemies to be Vulnerable.

===Vulnerable===
{{Quote|Hitting an enemy for the first time with a skill with {{G|Physical Status}} applies {{G|Vulnerable}} instead of the actual Physical Status. A {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy can be {{G|Lift|Lifted}} and {{G|Knock Down|Knocked Down}} to add more {{G|Vulnerable}} stacks (up to 4). Hitting a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy with {{G|Crush}} or {{G|Breach}} will consume the {{G|Vulnerable}} stacks.|Tutorial}}

When an Operator uses a Skill that can inflict a Physical Status, but the target has no {{G|Vulnerable}} stacks, the Skill will instead inflict {{G|Vulnerable}} indicated by a broken shield besides their Health Bar. The effect lasts temporarily.

If the Skill is casted on a target with Vulnerable however, the Physical Status will be applied, causing the target to also take additional damage.

Do note that [[Elite]], [[Alpha]], and [[Boss]] enemies are immune to the control effect such as {{G|Lift}}, but the Physical Status will still deal damage and Stagger as usual.

===Physical Status===
{{Main|Lift}}
{{Main|Knock Down}}
{{Main|Crush}}
{{Main|Breach}}

==Heat==
Heat [[Operator]]s are capable of doing Heat Damage, shown in-game as a red number.

{{List box|
    {{#cargo_query:
        |tables=Operators
        |fields=CONCAT("{{((}}C{{!}}", Operator, "{{!}}gridview=true{{))}}")=element_op
        |group by=Operator
        |order by=Operator ASC
        |where=Element="Heat"
        |delimiter = 
    }}
}}

Some Operators are also capable of applying '''Heat Infliction''', indicated by a fire icon besides the target's health bar.

When Operators apply {{G|Heat Infliction}} on enemies that are already have a Heat Infliction, a {{G|Heat Burst}} will be triggered, which deals some Heat DMG and adds one stack of {{G|Heat Infliction}}. 

===Combustion===
{{Main|Combustion}}
{{Quote|To an enemy with a non-Heat Arts Infliction, apply a Heat Infliction to consume both Arts Inflictions and trigger the {{Color|Combustion|3}} reaction: {{Color|making the target takes Heat DMG over time.|3}}|Tutorial}}

If Heat Infliction is dealt on enemies with another type of Arts Infliction, '''Combustion''' will be triggered instead, during which they take Heat Damage and for a period of time, they also take continuous Heat Damage over time. If Combustion is dealt again, the duration will refresh.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.

==Cryo==
Cryo [[Operator]]s are capable of doing Cryo Damage, shown in game as a cyan number.

{{List box|
    {{#cargo_query:
        |tables=Operators
        |fields=CONCAT("{{((}}C{{!}}", Operator, "{{!}}gridview=true{{))}}")=element_op
        |group by=Operator
        |order by=Operator ASC
        |where=Element="Cryo"
        |delimiter = 
    }}
}}

Some Operators are also capable of applying '''Cryo Infliction''', indicated by an ice icon besides the target's health bar.

When Operators apply Cryo Infliction on enemies that already have Cryo Infliction, a '''Cryo Burst''' will be triggered, during which they take massive Cryo Damage.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.

===Solidification===
{{Main|Solidification}}
{{Quote|To an enemy with a non-Cryo Arts Infliction, apply a Cryo Infliction to consume both Arts Inflictions and trigger the {{Color|Solidification|4}} reaction: {{Color|making the target temporarily unable to move.|4}}|Tutorial}}

If Cryo Infliction is dealt on enemies with another type of Arts Infliction, '''Solidification''' will be triggered instead, during which they take Cryo Damage, and for a period of time, they are unable to act. If Solidification is dealt again, the duration will refresh. [[Elite]] and [[Boss]] enemies are immune to the effect, though.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.

===Shatter===
{{Quote|To an enemy with active Solidification, apply Vulnerable or Physical Status effects to trigger '''Shatter''': consuming the Solidification and '''dealing massive Physical DMG.|Tutorial}}

If a Physical Status is dealt on enemies with Solidification, '''Shatter''' will be triggered, which removes Solidification, but dealing a massive amount of Physical Damage.

==Nature==
Nature [[Operator]]s are capable of doing Nature Damage, shown in game as a green number.

{{List box|
    {{#cargo_query:
        |tables=Operators
        |fields=CONCAT("{{((}}C{{!}}", Operator, "{{!}}gridview=true{{))}}")=element_op
        |group by=Operator
        |order by=Operator ASC
        |where=Element="Nature"
        |delimiter = 
    }}
}}

Some Operators are also capable of applying '''Nature Infliction''', indicated by a leaf icon besides to the target's health bar.

When Operators apply Nature Infliction on enemies that already have Nature Infliction, a '''Nature Burst''' will be triggered, during which they take massive Nature Damage.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.

===Corrosion===
{{Main|Corrosion}}
{{Quote|To an enemy with a non-Nature Arts Infliction, apply a Nature Infliction to consume both Arts Inflictions and trigger the {{Color|Corrosion|5}} reaction: {{Color|making the target gradually lose All Resistance over time.|5}}|Tutorial}}

If Nature Infliction is dealt on enemies with another type of Arts Infliction, '''Corrosion''' will be triggered instead, during which they takes Nature Damage, and for a period of time, they also have gradually reduced Resistance. If Corrosion is dealt again, the duration will refresh, but the effect won't.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.

==Electric==
Electric [[Operator]]s are capable of doing Electric Damage, shown in game as a yellow number.

{{List box|
    {{#cargo_query:
        |tables=Operators
        |fields=CONCAT("{{((}}C{{!}}", Operator, "{{!}}gridview=true{{))}}")=element_op
        |group by=Operator
        |order by=Operator ASC
        |where=Element="Electric"
        |delimiter = 
    }}
}}

Some Operators are also capable of applying '''Electric Infliction''', indicated by a lightning icon besides the target's health bar.

When Operators apply Electric Infliction on enemies that already have Electric Infliction, a '''Electric Burst''' will be triggered, during which they take massive Electric Damage.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.

===Electrification===
{{Main|Electrification}}
{{Quote|To an enemy with a non-Electric Arts Infliction, apply a Electric Infliction to consume both Arts Inflictions and trigger the {{Color|Electrification|6}} reaction: {{Color|making the target temporarily take more Arts DMG.|6}}|Tutorial}}

If Electric Infliction is dealt on enemies with another type of Arts Infliction, '''Electrification''' will be triggered instead, during which they take Electric Damage, and for a period of time, they take increased Arts Damage. If Electrification is dealt again, the duration will refresh.

The damage dealt this way is affected by the dealer's stats.
